description: Collect Quora questions, full answers, authors, and topics from URLs or best-effort keyword discovery.

answerSortOrder.description: Keep Quora's observed order, or sort by explicit upvotes or creation time.
answerSortOrder.title: Answer Sort Order

directUrls.description: Paste question, answer, profile, or topic URLs. Language subdomains such as es.quora.com are accepted. Invalid links are reported as status rows.
directUrls.title: Quora URLs

filterAiAnswers.description: Include all answers, exclude answers explicitly labelled as AI, or keep only those AI-labelled answers.
filterAiAnswers.title: AI Answers

includeAnswerHtml.description: Retain a simple HTML rendering of each answer alongside its plain text.
includeAnswerHtml.title: Include Answer HTML

includeAnswers.description: Emit answer rows and fetch answers beyond the first visible cards on question pages.
includeAnswers.title: Include Answers

includeAuthorProfiles.description: Open each discovered author's profile to add followers, following, answer/question counts, views, join date, and credential.
includeAuthorProfiles.title: Enrich Authors with Profile Stats

includeFieldEvidence.description: Add field_sources and fields_present metadata so each value can be traced to the page payload.
includeFieldEvidence.title: Include Field Evidence

includeMedia.description: Retain image and video links embedded in answer content.
includeMedia.title: Include Answer Media

includeOutboundLinks.description: Retain external links embedded in answer content.
includeOutboundLinks.title: Include Outbound Links

includeProfileSensitiveFields.description: Include location, employment, education, and join date on profile and author rows.
includeProfileSensitiveFields.title: Include Profile Location and Work History

includeRelatedQuestions.description: Follow the related-question links on each question page and scrape those questions too. This is the reliable discovery path when keyword search is gated.
includeRelatedQuestions.title: Discover Related Questions

includeSocialLinks.description: Include website and social links found on a profile.
includeSocialLinks.title: Include Social Links

maxAnswersPerQuestion.description: Answer cap for each question URL. Zero emits no answers from question pages.
maxAnswersPerQuestion.title: Maximum Answers per Question

maxAuthors.description: Maximum unique author rows emitted from answer evidence.
maxAuthors.title: Maximum Authors

maxItems.description: Hard cap on real data rows across the run. Status and manifest rows do not consume the cap.
maxItems.title: Maximum Total Rows

maxItemsPerSource.description: Cap real rows emitted from each URL or keyword. Zero means no per-source cap.
maxItemsPerSource.title: Maximum Rows per Source

maxRelatedQuestions.description: Related questions retained per question page and used as discovery seeds. Zero keeps all observed related questions.
maxRelatedQuestions.title: Maximum Related Questions

minAnswerUpvotes.description: Drop answers below this upvote count. Answers with no explicit upvote count are excluded when this is above zero.
minAnswerUpvotes.title: Minimum Answer Upvotes

mode.description: What to scrape. `urls` follows pasted Quora links. `search` discovers indexed question links for your keywords and expands related questions. `authors` builds author profiles from pasted profile or question URLs.
enumTitles: Questions, answers and topics from URLs
mode.title: Mode

onlyUnanswered.description: Keep only questions whose explicit answer count is exactly zero. Unknown counts are excluded.
onlyUnanswered.title: Only Unanswered Questions

resultTypes.description: Which entity rows to emit. Status and run-manifest rows are always written when relevant.
resultTypes.title: Result Types

searchQueries.description: Best-effort keyword discovery. Quora's own search page is gated for anonymous visitors, so results depend on the public web index; a run with no indexed matches returns a clear status row instead of invented results.
searchQueries.title: Keywords or Question Titles

usernames.description: Quora profile slugs, with or without a leading @ or trailing slash. Converted to profile URLs and merged with Quora URLs.
usernames.title: Profile Usernames

title: Quora Question & Author Scraper Input
